description: A shell script for testing and demonstrating git log options, including commit graph creation, merge operations, and various log output formats and filters.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Tags a git commit with a specified tag name.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Generates a simplified annotation of the current commit history, removing specific annotations.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Runs a git log command with specific formatting and compares the output to expected.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Wrapper around check_outcome for success cases.
